mapper.select: SELECT r.*, e.emp_no, e.name AS employee_name, d.name AS dept_name FROM hr_training_record r JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = r.employee_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id WHERE r.training_id = #{trainingId} ORDER BY e.emp_no

SELECT r.*, t.title AS training_title, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.hours, t.category, t.status AS training_status FROM hr_training_record r JOIN hr_training t ON t.id = r.training_id WHERE r.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY t.start_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_training_record (training_id, employee_id, attended, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{trainingId}, #{id}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.hours), 0) FROM hr_training_record r JOIN hr_training t ON t.id = r.training_id WHERE r.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND r.attended = 1 AND t.status = 'FINISHED' AND t.start_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
